title: Mutmaßliches Gewaltverbrechen – Zweiter Tatverdächtiger in Untersuchungshaft

extraction.summaryEn: A second suspect, aged 32, was remanded in custody over the abduction of a man in Waidmannslust on 23 April 2026. The police now investigate a homicide after a male body was found in a wooded area near Potsdam on 22 May.
